description: Create a custom stock indicator in JStock to filter for high momentum stocks. Open the Stock Indicator Editor (found in the 'Stock Indicator' menu) and create a new module named 'HighMomentum'. Add two conditions to this indicator: (1) 'Last Price' must be greater than 100.0, and (2) 'Volume' must be greater than 1,000,000. Ensure these conditions are combined with 'AND' logic so both must be true. Save/Install the indicator when finished.
